scope: QL10/P12 daily refresh path isolation; no provider refresh or promotion
confirmed_failure: With new_qlib_dir equal to qlib_dir and wipe_new_qlib_dir=true, validate_params returns no errors and ensure_dump_target_clean deletes the existing provider. Reproduced only in a task-local disposable sandbox.
implementation_plan: Use one shared role-map helper to expanduser then resolve(strict=False) and os.path.normcase the resulting absolute identities. Nonexistent staging/new suffixes remain valid; symlink loops, permission errors and other resolution failures fail closed. Compare Path component equality/ancestry via is_relative_to in both directions, never string-prefix matching. WindowsPath itself already compares case-insensitively; explicit normcase makes platform intent clear. Reject overlap between staging/new outputs and protected live provider/archive/CSV/index inputs and between staging and new roots.

Capture an explicit OSKH_SOURCE_PARQUET_ROOT pin once in config_from_args into a trailing optional RefreshConfig.source_parquet_root field (default None, no new CLI flag or reordered existing positional fields). Include it as a protected role. Validation/remover consume only that cfg field, not ambient environment. Direct config callers can supply it explicitly. Do not infer a disk or lake root from directory spelling.

Parameter validation and ensure_dump_target_clean both pass the entire configured role map to that same helper. In ensure_dump_target_clean, after skip_dump returns, perform the full check before dirty detection/wipe advice, and repeat it immediately before remover. This covers archive/CSV/index/whole SOURCE as well as live/staging even if wipe=false; never suggest a wipe flag for a protected alias. Normal CLI validation precedes child commands and dry-run output.

atomic_swap calls the same shared helper before any rename, supplying the two roots its existing public signature receives (new and live). Full config/inputs were checked by main; direct swap checks the complete available two-root contract, without inventing config inputs or changing its signature. Keep default flags, max_workers8, archive-overlay17-field workflow, integrity gates, rollback and successful output formats unchanged.

Add temporary-file preservation tests for equal/normalized/nested/ancestor paths, all protected sources and whole SOURCE. Exercise main refusal before preflight/steps, full-map remover refusal with zero remover calls, and swap refusal with zero renamer calls. Explicitly allow shared-prefix sibling names my_data, my_data_new_DATE, my_data_staging_DATE and backup names through validation, actual valid wipe and swap.

Test resolved directory aliases at all three sinks: validation, remover helper and swap. Creation capability alone may skip symlink cases; separate Windows-only case aliases exercise all three sinks without link privileges. Test missing output directories, whole SOURCE pin capture/sibling allowance and wipe=false protected aliases. Symlink races and concurrent writers are not solved by this ordinary operator-error validation.
validation: Show new negative tests fail against the frozen baseline without touching configured providers/lake.
